instructions:
1. Hold a weight plate in each hand and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
2. Let both plates rest on the floor at full stretch.
3. Row one plate up to your hip, squeezing the back.
4. Lower it back to a dead stop on the floor.
5. Repeat on the other side, alternating each rep.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Pause fully on the floor each rep to remove momentum.
2. Keep the spine neutral and core braced.
3. Pull with the elbow close to the body, not the arm.
4. Resist twisting the torso as you alternate sides.
name: Plate Alternating Deadstop Row

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and core braced.
2. Hold a weight plate with both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions.
3. Extend your arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
4. Rotate the plate like a steering wheel from one side to the other.
5. Keep the arms extended and shoulders stable throughout.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep arms straight and at shoulder height the whole set.
2. Brace the abdomen and exhale through each rotation.
3. Move under control, do not let the plate swing.
4. Keep shoulders down and away from the ears.
name: Plate Car Driver

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a weight plate on the floor between your feet.
2. Hinge and squat down, gripping the sides of the plate.
3. Drive through the legs and pull the plate up to shoulder height.
4. Press the plate overhead until the arms are extended.
5. Lower the plate back to the floor under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive with the legs and hips to start the clean, not the arms.
2. Brace the core to protect the lower back.
3. Keep the plate close to the body as it rises.
4. Press straight up with the plate over the midline.
name: Plate Clean And Press

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a medicine ball with both hands.
2. Drop into a quarter squat and rotate the ball down toward one hip.
3. Drive up through the legs while sweeping the ball diagonally across the body.
4. Finish with the ball high on the opposite side, pivoting the back foot.
5. Reverse the motion back down to the start.
6. Repeat, then switch sides.
tips:
1. Initiate the rotation from the hips and core, not the arms.
2. Keep the core braced and avoid arching the lower back.
3. Pivot the trailing foot to let the hips rotate freely.
4. Move with control rather than throwing the ball.
name: Low Rotational Med Ball Chops Quarter Squat, Rotating Med Ball Left And Ride Across Core

instructions:
1. Stand on a rebounder with feet together and knees soft.
2. Bounce and jump your feet out to about shoulder-width.
3. Land softly through the balls of the feet.
4. Bounce again and bring your feet back together.
5. Keep the core braced and bounces controlled.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Land softly through the balls of the feet to absorb impact.
2. Keep the knees soft and tracking over the toes.
3. Brace the core to stay balanced on the unstable surface.
4. Keep bounces low and rhythmic rather than high.
name: Rebounder In & Out From Ground
